content.text: The grant clause meets the preferred position on every material term.

input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position. The subscription grant in 13.1 runs to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (no written-notice precondition needed), 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence for paid-up software and Vendor Technology including Affiliates and contractor support, and 13.3 bars revocation or suspension except for uncured material payment/use breach after notice and cure, and permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor via Section 24.1, which allows assignment to an M&A successor without Vendor consent. Nothing is revocable at Vendor's discretion, so no redline is warranted.
